testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: Verify branch is rebased on base (needs pull-request context and full git history, not the worktree); Validate renovate.json (fetches renovate from the npm registry via npx on every run); smoke-omp (needs bun and a globally installed pinned omp binary); install-and-smoke (needs bun and a globally installed pinned omp binary).

unverified.claim: The new comment says the 30-minute cap sits "well above the suite's normal runtime", but repo evidence puts the suite at roughly 10 minutes locally and up to the old 15-minute limit on CI, so 30 is about 2-3x rather than clearly far above.
unverified.evidence: test-run.log: duration_ms 606987 (~10.1 min) for this PR's suite. docs/metrics/runs/2026-11-06T080041Z/ledger.md:127 records the check job cancelled at its 15-minute limit on #4353 (twice). ci.yml line 110 is now 30. The wording is defensible, but the 15-minute observation shows normal CI runtime can approach the old cap.
unverified.suggested_fix: Optional: state the measured runtime, e.g. "suite runs ~10 min locally; CI has hit 15", instead of the unquantified "well above".

unverified.claim: PR body and commit b09175d7: all assertions check out — timeout 15 to 30 on the check job only (diff confirms one hunk), the comment rewritten as described, and other jobs' caps unchanged (10 and 5 minutes in the snapshot).
unverified.evidence: grep -n timeout-minutes .github/workflows/*.yml: ci.yml:110=30, :277/:299/:336=10, pin-drift 5, release-label 5/5, release 10.
